style_prompt: Editorial-quality flowchart diagram, hand-drawn line work on warm off-white paper background (#F7F4ED). Two-tone palette of deep Alberta navy (#1A3A6E) for primary nodes and rust orange (#C2491A) for accents and arrows. No photo realism, no people, no logos, no watermarks. All text labels in English.
